annotations.limitation: Name metric is descriptive and requires independent human adjudication for gold-label claims. Only2 identifier spans; identifier recovery is a case report, not a population estimate.
annotations.source: AI-assisted pre-outcome semantic names; deterministic lexical number/identifier proxies

baseline_gap: Backward direction remains heuristic; SIPIT is existing budgeted independent implementation. BiSR is not included or claimed reproduced.

budget_review.planning_contingency: 25–50% scenario, about133–160GB10 GPU-hours; excludes training/setup/capture/scoring/I/O/analysis. Not a guaranteed bound.

compute: Measured per-arm online work plus applicable model loading, public calibration, and exact-head export cost. Report cold and amortized costs; victim training is separate. No equal-cost claim across SIPIT and beam. Randomized arm order.
data: Disjoint calibration, victim-training and untouched evaluation documents; pinned tokenized input and annotations hash required. Names annotated before predictions. Evaluation text is public benchmark text, not evidence of actual sensitive-data harm.

execution.checkpoint: Per-cell hash-chained measurement events and immutable predictions; report checkpoint after each victim run and at completion/failure. No outcome-based retries.
execution.meaning: Inference forward/SIPIT rows reference the corresponding measured training-probe execution because h, head, calibration, attack seed and budget are identical. Reused rows are not additional runtime measurements.

probe: Same held-out documents and fixed post-training victim state, dropout disabled. Training probe exposes next-token-loss seam gradient; inference exposes activations only. No probe updates. This is not an online training trajectory.

statistics.generalization: Crossed bootstrap accounts for evaluation documents and victim training randomness, conditional on this single fixed128-document training corpus. It does not estimate variation across independently sampled training corpora.
statistics.missing: No complete-case deletion. Any missing/failed cell blocks comparative analysis; retain failure and rerun entire run in a fresh directory with same protocol.
statistics.secondary_correction: Bonferroni percentile bootstrap intervals across all prespecified secondary contrasts
statistics.stopping: Exactly 256 fixed evaluation documents,128 fixed victim-training documents,32 fixed calibration documents and10 independent training seeds; no outcome-driven sample extension. Report achieved precision; no power guarantee.
statistics.unit: crossed document and independently trained victim run; average attack seeds first
